ideas.pitch: An analytical platform for head-to-head competitive programming matches using graph intelligence to map coder strengths and weaknesses.
ideas.title: DuelsGraph: 1v1 CP Matchmaking & Performance Graph Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeted directly at the core theme of the IIITD Programming League by providing advanced performance analysis for 1v1 competitive programming matches.

ideas.pitch: A high-speed WebSocket-powered coding duel platform that brings knockout-style head-to-head programming battles to life with instant test-case execution.
ideas.title: AlgoClash: Real-Time 1v1 Algorithm Duel Arena
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the exact knockout and head-to-head format of the IPL event, making it an engaging demonstration piece for judges and competitors alike.

ideas.pitch: A localized RAG-based assistant that instantly indexes competitive programming problem archives to generate optimized algorithmic editorials and hints.
ideas.title: CP-RAG: AI-Powered Competitive Programming Coach and Editorial Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a major pain point for competitive programmers practicing under tight time constraints, utilizing proven multi-agent and RAG patterns.

ideas.pitch: An AST-based static analysis tool that predicts execution time and memory complexity for Python and C++ submissions to prevent TLE verdicts.
ideas.title: CodeTracer: Algorithmic Complexity and Time-Limit-Exceeded Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Involves genuine hard engineering in static code analysis and complexity estimation, which appeals to competitive programming judges.

ideas.pitch: A streamlined live scoreboard and automated tournament bracket visualizer designed for fast-paced 1v1 knockout elimination events.
ideas.title: BracketLive: Automated Tournament Tree & Live Telemetry for CP Leagues
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides immediate utility for organizers running a national-level knockout league with real-time state management.
